name: PromptComposer
summary: Compose local multiline messages with native validation and caller-owned send, model, file and suggestion actions.

useWhen: Compose local multiline messages with native validation and caller-owned send, model, file and suggestion actions.
avoidWhen: Executing remote tasks, managing backend state or simulating assistant processing.

obligations: Attachments are supplied display records; optional onRemoveAttachment reports IDs. onFilesSelected opens a native file picker and receives File[] without upload, capture or remote access. Model controls render only with supplied models and onModelChange, using selectedModel or defaultSelectedModel and the existing Select popup, keyboard and focus behavior. Dictation renders only when onDictation is wired and performs no recognition itself.

Pending makes text readonly, disables auxiliary actions, and exposes Stop only when onStop exists; disabled prevents all editing and actions. Empty/whitespace text disables Send. error is visible, associated with the textarea and announced. No pending state, backend, dictation, upload or timers are simulated.

behavior: The native form host/ref and native onSubmit, onChange and onReset retain their event meanings. onSend(value) is the domain callback. Submission of the composer host prevents page navigation; a consumer-cancelled onSubmit also cancels onSend. An inputProps.form association instead gives the external form ownership of native validation and submission for both Enter and Send; its consumer prevents navigation, and local onSend/onSubmit do not run. Auxiliary controls use type=button.

value/onValueChange or defaultValue govern controlled/uncontrolled text. inputProps forwards native textarea attributes and events, including name, required, maxLength, rows and form; inputRef points to that textarea. Enter requests native form submission and validity; Shift+Enter inserts a newline and composition never submits.

Uncontrolled form reset restores defaultValue and defaultSelectedModel (or the first supplied model). Controlled values remain caller-owned; native reset handlers can prevent the reset. Reset of an associated external form synchronizes only its textarea; local model state and the composer host onReset remain local. The textarea grows up to its bounded scroll viewport.

Sources and commands use stable id/label/description/insertText records. A caret token beginning @ or / at a word boundary filters suggestions. Up/Down chooses, Enter inserts, Escape dismisses; pointer selection preserves input focus. Insertion replaces only the current token, respects maxLength and never auto-sends. onSuggestionSelect reports the chosen record and kind.

Attachments are supplied display records; optional onRemoveAttachment reports IDs. onFilesSelected opens a native file picker and receives File[] without upload, capture or remote access. Model controls render only with supplied models and onModelChange, using selectedModel or defaultSelectedModel and the existing Select popup, keyboard and focus behavior. Dictation renders only when onDictation is wired and performs no recognition itself.

Pending makes text readonly, disables auxiliary actions, and exposes Stop only when onStop exists; disabled prevents all editing and actions. Empty/whitespace text disables Send. error is visible, associated with the textarea and announced. No pending state, backend, dictation, upload or timers are simulated.
accessibility: Preserve native host/ref/events and keyboard controls with visible focus.
Use semantic labels and static status announcements; do not rely on color or continuously animated processing.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
